quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: From top to bottom, traffic lights are ordered:
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are arranged red on top, yellow in the middle, and green on the bottom.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: When you see this sign for a railroad crossing without signals, you should:

options.text: Keep a steady speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Slow down and check for trains in both directions. Listen carefully and be ready to stop if you see or hear a train coming. Never try to speed across the tracks ahead of a train.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to dangers ahead. This sign warns you of an upcoming curve to the right.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign shows that the road will curve sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs warn you about school zones. Watch for children and obey the posted speed limit.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not permitted at this location.

questions.question: Orange signs are used for:
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn you about construction and maintenance work ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead is now divided by a median. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: When you see this red and white sign, you should:

options.text: Stop and check for traffic from both directions before proceeding.
Let traffic on the road you want to enter or cross go first.
Drive at a steady speed and check for traffic from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let traffic on the road you want to enter or cross go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let any vehicles, cyclists, or pedestrians pass before you go. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right only after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that shows rules drivers must follow. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign shows rules drivers must obey. It means parking is not allowed here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A downhill slope or hill is ahead.
The road will become narrower ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A downhill slope or hill is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downhill slope or hill ahead. The hill may be long or steep, or it may have sharp curves.

questions.question: When you see this road sign, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign means a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not go until it is safe to pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Left turns are not allowed here.
A left turn is allowed only after stopping.
All drivers must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left turns are not allowed here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
Trucks are not allowed on the upcoming hill.
Trucks are on the upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downward slope is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: One lane is ending. Traffic must merge to the left.
A highway entrance ramp is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: One lane is ending. Traffic must merge to the left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns drivers that the number of lanes is reducing and traffic needs to merge left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light or slow for a yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location. You often see this sign where traffic comes from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards. Round signs are only used to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A sharp turn to the right.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.question: What does a sign with this shape mean?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks the start of a no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane ends ahead. Drivers in that lane must merge into another lane.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, what does it mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right due to construction.
The road ahead turns at a very sharp angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns at a very sharp angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to dangers ahead. This sign tells you to slow down for a very sharp turn in the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left then right.
The road curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that the road will curve right first, then curve left. Slow down and be ready for these curves.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic are about to become one lane.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a full stop and look for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: When approaching a railroad crossing, look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Let any trains pass before you cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.

questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers of construction zones ahead. Slow down and drive carefully through work areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway ends ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road will curve right and then left. Slow down to safely take these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must yield to them.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane ends ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles or pedestrians to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers they cannot turn left at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that a sharp turn is coming up. You should slow down before the turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that an upcoming bridge is narrow. You may not have enough space to pass a truck on the bridge. Be careful and slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that a traffic light is coming up. Be ready to stop for a red light or slow down for a yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds in a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers the road becomes slippery when wet. Slow down when the pavement is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill slope is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in this direction.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, it means:

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right due to roadwork ahead.
Slow down because the road ahead turns sharply.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead turns sharply.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead will turn sharply. Slow down before the turn, just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: The posted speed limit shows:

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The highest safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
The highest safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the limit depending on conditions. Drive slower when conditions are poor.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is unsafe and illegal to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a sharp right turn is coming.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid crashes and brake damage.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Cars on the right go first.
Let cross traffic pass before you go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before you go.
questions.explanation: This sign means you must yield the right-of-way. Slow down and let other vehicles and pedestrians cross before you proceed. Stop if needed.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It tells you that an island, median, or barrier is ahead. Stay to the right of it.

questions.question: This bicyclist is signaling:
questions.explanation: Bicycles don't have turn signals. Bicyclists use hand and arm signals instead. A straight left arm means they will turn left.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns drivers about a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.
The road ahead curves left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming road hazards. This sign warns that the road curves to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic laws that you must follow. This sign means you cannot turn right where it is posted.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?
questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about motorist services. These include rest areas, food, gas, and hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs warn about work zones. Stay alert for unexpected driving conditions. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead. You must follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns. You cannot use it to pass traffic or drive straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign warn about?

options.text: Road turns sharply right, then left.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse curve. The road curves right, then curves left.

questions.question: What is the main concern with this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may be misaligned because one side of your car is higher.
You might damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
You might hydroplane if the shoulder is wet.
You might lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You might lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or steer sharply. This could cause you to lose control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns of a T intersection ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers what traffic laws they must follow. You must drive in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign shows that pedestrians cross here. When you see it, watch for people crossing the road and let them cross safely.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains go first.
questions.explanation: This round sign shows a railroad crossing ahead. It is placed a few hundred feet before the tracks. It tells you to slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is to the right.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through it means the action is not allowed. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest speed you can legally drive on this road. In rain, snow, ice, or bad conditions, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: This sign tells you that:

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a winding road with three or more curves ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that when turning left at a green light, you must let oncoming traffic go first. You can complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is ahead. Enter slowly and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted where you cannot enter. You might see it on one-way streets or if you try to go the wrong way on an expressway ramp.

questions.question: When you see an octagonal sign, you must:
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop, check for traffic and pedestrians, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A three-sided sign tells you to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and carpools with at least two people.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
Two lanes of opposite traffic are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not go under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a stop sign is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is moving in both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you there is a side road intersection ahead.

questions.question: If you see a flashing red traffic light, you should:

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Treat it like a stop sign.
May not proceed until it changes to green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. Stop completely at the stop line or before the crosswalk. Then yield to all other traffic and pedestrians before entering the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the divided highway is ending ahead. Be ready to change lanes or adjust your position.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you a railroad crossing is coming. Look and listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you go.

questions.question: A sign with this shape means:
questions.explanation: A diamond-shaped yellow sign warns of danger ahead. Orange diamond signs warn of dangers in or near work areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead. The road splits into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. You must stay on the right side.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light at an intersection means you should:

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: When you see a flashing yellow light, slow down and go carefully. You do not have to stop completely.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a "Yield" sign. When you see it, slow down and check for traffic. Let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop only if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a steep downgrade is coming. You should check your brakes.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of passengers.
Specific turns are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes must merge smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of passengers.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. HOV lanes are for buses and cars with a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you to watch for traffic entering from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming and you should get ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates, disabled veteran license plates, or disability parking placards.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and get ready to stop if cars are coming.
Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
Drive carefully through the intersection without always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection where you can see all traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic may be merging into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangle sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community group is picking up trash ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
A divided highway is coming up.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic flows in both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means the action is not allowed. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: A triangle sign means yield. Slow down as you approach an intersection with this sign and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Reduce speed when the pavement is wet.
The road ahead has many turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce speed when the pavement is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down in wet conditions, avoid sudden braking or turns, and keep more distance between your vehicle and the one ahead.

questions.question: An orange sign like this means:
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of construction areas. Drive with caution.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: May either continue through or exit from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through.
Must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will exit the freeway and will not continue through the interchange. You can change lanes to go through, or you must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns of wet road conditions that can make your car hard to control. Slow down because it takes longer to stop on wet pavement.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the roadway in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: When you see this sign, it means:

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction the chevron points. You may see several of these signs throughout the curve.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should:

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road splits ahead and you must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
